proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Lahnda jaṇā person/husband, Awankari jaṇā person and Punjabi jaṇā. The Pothwari and Gujari responses preserve that western jana family, including ordinary final-vowel and nasalized variants; mixed answers with bandā or ādmī are excluded.
